name: samemark
tagline: The same mdast as remark-parse, up to 10x faster, with streaming for chat UIs
summary: samemark returns the same mdast tree as remark-parse with GFM, positions included, and replaces it in a unified pipeline with one import. Your remark plugins keep working, and the whole markdown to HTML run gets several times faster. A second entry, samemark/stream, parses chat answers incrementally so streaming UIs stop re-parsing the whole message on every token.

features: Same mdast as mdast-util-from-markdown with GFM, positions included, checked node by node against micromark
remarkParseFast is a drop-in for remark-parse in unified, Astro and react-markdown
remark-gfm, remark-frontmatter and remark-math are handled natively; other extensions are passed to the real parser, so the output stays correct
samemark/stream parses chat output incrementally and matches a full parse after every chunk, so finished blocks keep their object identity for React.memo
Plain JavaScript, no native binary, runs in Node 18+, browsers, Deno, Bun and edge runtimes
how_it_works: A hand-written fast path parses markdown straight into the mdast node shapes micromark produces, with no micromark at parse time.
Any setup it does not reproduce exactly (other micromark extensions, custom frontmatter fences) is detected and handed to mdast-util-from-markdown, so you always get micromark's answer.
The stream parser re-parses only the unfinished tail of the message and reuses every finished block, so a push costs the new text, not the whole answer.
quickstart:
import {unified} from 'unified'
import remarkGfm from 'remark-gfm'
import remarkRehype from 'remark-rehype'
import rehypeStringify from 'rehype-stringify'
import remarkParseFast from 'samemark'

const file = await unified()
  .use(remarkParseFast) // instead of remark-parse
  .use(remarkGfm)
  .use(remarkRehype)
  .use(rehypeStringify)
  .process('# Hello *world*')
